title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android: Facilitator AI notes for in-person meetings
summary: The briefing accurately reports the Android rollout notice and distinguishes it from conflicting Learn availability and preview statements. The control paths, commands, default and qualified Teams Rooms Pro licensing are supported; no corrections are required.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance guidance: Before rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: The Pro Management portal path is Rooms > room > Settings > Device > Show Take notes button on the home screen.
claims.quote: In Pro Management portal, select Rooms from the left navigation > select your desired room > Settings > Device > Show Take notes button on the home screen.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Why it matters; Risk assessment: Change & support
claims.claim: The room-level Show Take notes button on the home screen setting is enabled by default.
claims.quote: Show Take notes button on the home screen. The default setting is enabled.

claims.claim: No API for the room-level Take notes setting is documented at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: "Show Take notes button" API PowerShell Teams Rooms Pro management; site:learn.microsoft.com/powershell "Teams Rooms" "Take notes"; site:learn.microsoft.com/graph "Teams Rooms" "note" settings. Read Rooms Facilitator and Loop configuration pages; no setting API found.

claims.claim: The transcription path is Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Transcription.
claims.quote:
go to Meetings > Meeting policies.
2. Select the policy that you want to edit or create a new one.
3. Toggle Transcription On or Off.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity Global -AllowTranscription $true enables transcription in the Global meeting policy.
claims.quote: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity Global -AllowTranscription $true

claims.claim: The transcription row describes a general user meeting policy rather than a separate in-person Facilitator control.
claims.quote: Transcription is both a per-organizer and per-user policy setting. For meetings and events to include transcripts, the organizer must have this setting turned on. The user who starts the recording or transcript must also have this setting turned on.

claims.claim: Set-SPOTenant -IsLoopEnabled $true enables Loop components in Teams.
claims.quote: To enable Loop components in Teams, run Set-SPOTenant -IsLoopEnabled $true.

claims.claim: No admin-centre path is documented for setting IsLoopEnabled.
claims.quote: Searched: "IsLoopEnabled" "admin center" configure Teams. Read Admin policies for Loop components and Loop workspaces in full: Teams uses SharePoint PowerShell; its admin-centre checkbox controls Loop workspaces, not IsLoopEnabled.

claims.claim: IsLoopEnabled applies tenant-wide and cannot be configured per user.
claims.quote: This property controls Loop component creation and integration in Microsoft Teams. It applies to the entire tenant and can't be configured at the user level.

claims.claim: Set-SPOTenant -IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled $true enables collaborative meeting notes in Teams.
claims.quote: [Teams-only] `Set-SPOTenant -IsLoopEnabled $true`, `Set-SPOTenant -IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled $true`

claims.claim: No admin-centre path is documented for setting IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled.
claims.quote: Searched: "IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled" "admin center" configure. Read Admin policies for Loop components and Loop workspaces and Set up Facilitator in Microsoft Teams: this property is managed in SharePoint PowerShell, not the Cloud Policy UI for New Calendar.

claims.claim: IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled applies tenant-wide and cannot be configured per user.
claims.quote: This property controls the collaborative meeting notes creation and integration in Microsoft Teams. It applies to the entire tenant and can't be configured at the user level.

claims.claim: The SharePoint collaborative-meeting-notes property does not apply to Teams New Calendar collaborative meeting notes.
claims.quote: The SharePoint organization property doesn't apply to collaborative meeting notes in Teams New Calendar, see Settings management in Cloud Policy.

claims.claim: Facilitator can be allowed or blocked through Teams admin center > Teams apps > Manage apps > Facilitator > Allow or Block in the actions menu.
claims.quote:
In the left rail navigation, select Teams apps > Manage apps.
3. In the apps list's search box, search for Facilitator.
4. Select Facilitator from the app list.
5. In the actions menu, select Allow or Block.

claims.claim: The Facilitator app is allowed by default.
claims.quote: Facilitator is allowed by default.

claims.claim: Blocking all apps for the organisation also blocks Facilitator.
claims.quote: However, if all apps are blocked for your organization, Facilitator is also blocked.

claims.claim: The Rooms Learn page gives the Pro Management portal path without a platform qualification.
claims.quote: Searched: "Show Take notes button" API PowerShell Teams Rooms Pro management. Read Facilitator in Microsoft Teams Rooms in full: Step 4 gives the room settings path without naming Windows or Android; the separate FAQ supplies the availability caveat reported in the briefing.

claims.claim: Learn does not specify which account's transcription policy governs unscheduled in-person Facilitator notes.
claims.quote: Searched: "Facilitator" "Teams Rooms" "transcription" "policy". Read Rooms Facilitator setup and FAQ, meeting-transcription-captions, and Teams Rooms and Copilot overview excerpts; general policies are documented but the in-person account/policy mapping is not specified.

claims.claim: The Facilitator in Teams Rooms page names no meter or separate charge for in-person notes.
claims.quote: Searched: "Facilitator" "Teams Rooms" "meter" pricing. Read Facilitator in Microsoft Teams Rooms and Microsoft Teams Rooms licenses in full; the feature page states current Pro inclusion with a preview warning, but names no meter or separate in-person-notes charge.

claims.claim: The general Facilitator setup page says Loop file generation was discontinued on 31 July 2026.
claims.quote: As part of this change, Loop file generation has been discontinued as of July 31, 2026.

claims.claim: The general Facilitator setup page says live notes are unaffected by the Loop file generation change.
claims.quote: Facilitator live notes remain unaffected.
